name: Togetherness
source:
You play as Joshua, a thoughtful man on a date with his bubbly wife Karen. They're very much in love, and nothing will tear them apart.

[From:[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=46821&sid=6987fc096675d4a8f82e3aa83c6e562a]Lemmasoft[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演体贴的男人约书亚，与活泼的妻子凯伦约会。两人深爱彼此，没有什么能够拆散他们。

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=46821&sid=6987fc096675d4a8f82e3aa83c6e562a]LemmaSoft[/url]]
